description: Bioinformatic domain architecture: hydropathy (signal peptide + GPI tail) and LRR motif periodicity in nyctalopin
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seq = "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9GZU5.fasta", timeout=25).text.splitlines()[1:])
N = len(seq)
print("Nyctalopin Q9GZU5 length:", N)

# Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy
kd = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
      'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
      'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=9
hyd=[np.mean([kd[a] for a in seq[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]]) for i in range(N)]

# LRR consensus motif LxxLxLxxNxL (allow I/V for L; N can be N/C/T/S)
motif = re.compile(r'[LIVF]..[LIVF].[LIVF]..[NCTSL].[LIVF]')
hits=[m.start() for m in motif.finditer(seq)]
print("Approx LRR-consensus motif matches:", len(hits), "at positions", hits[:15])

# N-term signal peptide window & C-term GPI hydrophobic tail
print("N-term mean hydropathy (1-20): %.2f (signal peptide)" % np.mean(hyd[:20]))
print("C-term mean hydropathy (last 20): %.2f (GPI-anchor tail)" % np.mean(hyd[-20:]))
print("Core mean hydropathy (30..-30): %.2f" % np.mean(hyd[30:-30]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.5))
ax.plot(range(1,N+1),hyd,color='steelblue',lw=0.9)
ax.axhline(0,color='grey',lw=0.6)
for h in hits:
    ax.axvspan(h+1,h+11,color='orange',alpha=0.12)
ax.axvspan(1,25,color='green',alpha=0.2,label='N-term signal peptide')
ax.axvspan(N-25,N,color='red',alpha=0.2,label='C-term GPI-anchor signal')
ax.set_xlabel('Residue'); ax.set_ylabel('KD hydropathy (w=9)')
ax.set_title('Nyctalopin (Q9GZU5): N-term signal peptide, central LRR array (orange), C-term GPI-anchor tail')
ax.legend(loc='upper right',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('nyctalopin_architecture.png',dpi=120)
print("saved plot")
